paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者在新谈话里听到熟悉的说话节奏，却还说不清具体像哪次经历；另一次则能认出熟悉的措辞。熟悉的体验与辨认出来源不必同时发生。三条回答不检验记忆准确，也不提供曾经相遇、心灵感应或双方感受一致的证据；例子不需要寻找旧记录或请别人确认。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader notices a familiar rhythm in a new conversation without identifying an earlier experience. On another occasion, a familiar phrase can be recognised. Familiarity and an identified source need not occur together. Three answers test no memory accuracy and provide no evidence of an earlier meeting, telepathy or matching feelings. The scene requires no old-record search or confirmation by someone else.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“只读虚构情境，哪句话描述感受，哪句话开始解释感受？”可以让解释继续未定。听者不替别人指定特殊角色，不把熟悉感当作继续联系的理由，也不要求证明或否定体验；只描述第一人称的片刻即可结束。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card asks which sentence describes a feeling in the fictional scene and which begins an explanation. Leave that explanation open if preferred. A listener assigns nobody a special role, uses no familiarity as a reason for continued contact and requires neither proof nor dismissal of the experience. A first-person description can be the last step.

paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, two people mention the same hobby: one values quiet involvement and the other shared discussion. An expressed overlap and their separate reasons remain distinct. A shared interest supplies neither someone’s preferred use of time nor an unspoken preference. The scene requires no personal-information search, additional questions or compatibility calculation.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“只在虚构谈话里，双方实际说过的交集是什么？它还不能说明什么？”可以只指出一个细节。听者不把不同解释当作相似失效，也不把相似升级成命定或相容证明；无需比结果、给别人作答或分享私人对话。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card asks what overlap was actually expressed in a fictional exchange and what it does not establish. One detail is enough. A listener treats different explanations as no cancellation of that overlap and upgrades no similarity into destiny or compatibility. No result comparison, answer on someone else’s behalf or private conversation is needed.

paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader wants to sort out a view after a vivid conversation but does not recall whether contact actually changed. On another occasion, time before continuing was wanted. Desired pace, action and an explanation of its cause can differ. The scene calls no pause a Runner stage, predicts no pursuit and requires neither another intense exchange nor new contact to complete a memory.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“只看虚构情境，先分开想暂停、是否暂停和别人如何理解，其中哪些仍未知？”无需询问对方。听者不把放慢当作关系策略或成长义务，也不把低均值当作没有边界；可以只保留愿望的描述，不建议靠近或退开。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card separates a fictional wish for a pause, whether it occurred and another person’s understanding, leaving unknowns unknown. Nobody needs to be asked. A listener turns no slower pace into a relationship strategy or growth duty and treats no lower mean as absent boundaries. Keep only the wish described, without advice to approach or withdraw.

paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, two people give different meanings to talking again: a short conversation or a later time. A reader recalls checking one meaning but does not know whether understanding later matched. The action differs from achieved mutual understanding. More checking certifies neither certainty nor communication skill here. The scene requires no reopened conversation or repeated requested answer.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“只为虚构措辞列出两种含义，哪些部分还没有说定？”可以只读不回答。听者不借结果要求证明特殊连接，也不假设多确认就一定更好；一方不想继续谈的意愿独立保留，不把未知变成必须解决的题。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card lists two meanings of a fictional phrase and what remains unspecified. Read without answering if preferred. A listener uses no result to demand proof of a special bond and assumes no greater benefit from more checking. A wish not to continue remains separate; an unknown is no required problem to solve.

paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader notices a preference for an unhurried hour after discussing free time and later describes it differently. Meaning can be revised without another person accepting a teacher, healer or destined role. More frequent reflection establishes neither greater maturity, growth nor a truer interpretation, and implies no return to the exchange.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“只读虚构人物的句子，哪部分是自己的偏好，哪部分是在给别人安排角色？”可以保留一个朴素观察。听者不把不舒服说成必须经历的成长，不要求分享记忆或继续分析每次互动；没有下一步行动，也可以结束。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card distinguishes a fictional person’s preference from a role assigned to someone else. Keep one modest observation if useful. A listener describes no discomfort as required growth and requests neither a shared memory nor analysis of every interaction. Reading can end without a further action.
